author: BourbonBonobo
body:
Heyo!

Merry christmas guys! 

I'm going to buy a new MC account, due to the fact that I'm sick of my name. I would love some name suggestions! Here are some of my favorite things; I love the Warriors NBA team, my favorite number is 99, I want to have a name that sounds more related to mine craft, and I would like to have a name related to a warrior or some type of person/animal that fights. I would love to hear your suggestions!!!

Thanks!
